budget.shared_concurrency_or_physical_limit_cha: 별도 근거와 기존 비용 한도 내 검증 전 변경하지 않는다.

yearly_rule_read.source: Current approved guide repository and exact rule/qualification references. Locally prepared fields do not silently supersede the current DB release.
yearly_rule_read.native_preservation: Preserve strings, integers and decimal lexemes, field presence, actual zero, null, unknown and not-applicable distinctly. Preserve percentage versus score/deduction/bonus units and all conditional rules. Stored JSONB native values and retained field-presence/type metadata are distinct from pre-DB source bytes; JSONB cannot reconstruct an original numeric lexeme or original JSON-string encoding.
yearly_rule_read.bounded_read: Parameterized exact year+PK lookup with the existing approved read role, source-head/qualification guard, request budget and finite response bound. No all-school raw table, private model, coefficients or review history in the response.
yearly_rule_read.lineage: Cross-year comparison requires the existing verified lineage_button_link_allowed=true relation. Similar names or equal PK text across years do not establish a relation.
yearly_rule_read.consumers: Owner server services compose comparison and display sentences from approved fields; the data/scoring owner retains SQL, repository adapters and conversion/percentile/decision engines.
yearly_rule_read.interpretation: A changed weight alone does not prove a particular student gained or lost. Student-specific statements require the separately verified current-year evidence contract.
acceptance: exact identity and source head; wrong year/PK rejected
native type/unit and null/zero distinctions preserved
same-year rule exceptions and cross-year lineage preserved
no model/raw source/review payload or new authorization exposure

test_registration_policy.rule: Valid exact registration, existing professional source registry, verification layer/source/index SHA and selected-snapshot static import must all pass. Only this Guide test is excluded from public read3 classification. Unregistered neighbors, metadata or snapshot drift and native/operating promotion fail closed.
test_registration_policy.count: Positive native integer matches additive_guide_tests; actual separate suite JUnit count and existing21 operation-test names remain mandatory. Do not fix future total131/142 in common code.
test_registration_policy.validation: Synthetic metadata/snapshot counterexamples only; no service data, SQL writes, native acceptance, new HTTP operation or Owner permission.

owner_tip_followup_20261023.classification_basis: Copy only the approved engine converted score and adopted expected range with the same offering/year/scale. The verified prior official publication URL is a source reference; it does not make the service expected range a university announcement.
owner_tip_followup_20261023.population_and_policy: comparison_context.population_id identifies the actual verified student population. Do not fill it with a decision-policy version; preserve policy_version under its own explicit contract field.
owner_tip_followup_20261023.precision: Do not derive counseling differences by converting exact native decimal strings to a JavaScript Number. Preserve the original score/range or use the existing exact arithmetic.
owner_tip_followup_20261023.additional_codes: rule_weight_change and prior_competition remain separate proposed contracts until source/schema/tests are synchronized. Current ready-only filtering is retained; unimplemented pending reasons do not bypass it.
owner_tip_followup_20261023.reserve_and_count: Last admitted reserve number (번) and actual additional admitted people (명) are distinct metrics. Never use one as the other in prior_competition.
owner_tip_followup_20261023.historical_spread: A within-year 50%-to-70% gap is different from a three-year 70%-cut movement. Keep separate code/label/axis definitions and do not pool incomparable cohorts/scales.
owner_tip_followup_20261023.print: Only the same fixed report revision and authorized org/student evidence may be included in the print projection; no new unapproved calculation or customer data logging.

advantage_definition.definition: delta_pp = approved baseline inclusive upper-cumulative percentile minus the university-converted-score inclusive upper-cumulative percentile; positive=favorable, negative=unfavorable, zero=neutral.
advantage_definition.baseline: The engine baseline is the approved current-year target total distribution for Korean+math+inquiry1+inquiry2 standard scores; it is not an arbitrary prior-year raw score or a score/max ratio.
advantage_definition.guards: Same academic year, exam, actual population, validated nonsynthetic distribution, approved baseline version and include_equal tie policy. Missing or incompatible evidence returns null/pending; no zero substitution.
advantage_definition.limitation: This is a percentage-point position difference, not admission probability or an assurance that last-year results repeat.
